scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.cpSync(path.join('api'),path.join('dist','api'),{recursive:true});console.log('api copied to dist')"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html','index.html');if(!fs.existsSync('assets'))fs.mkdirSync('assets');fs.cpSync('dist/assets','assets',{recursive:true});console.log('dist deployed to root')"
